name: cgbp_ingest_document
description: CGB Pulse: create a cgbp_document record for an uploaded file, read it with the OCR/LLM extraction interface, store summary, key points, metrics, risks and recommendations.

file_source.title: file_source
file_source.description: Storage key of the uploaded file (FileUpload block: files[0].source).

parameters.systemPrompt: You analyse government service documents uploaded to CGB Pulse, a performance command centre for Qatar government services. Use only what the document says. Never invent a figure. Return ONLY a JSON object.
parameters.prompt: Read the attached document and return JSON with exactly these keys: {"doc_type": "report|memo|letter|complaint|policy|other", "title": "the document title", "summary": "2-3 sentences with the most important facts and figures", "key_points": ["max 5 short points, each with a number if the document has one"], "metrics": [{"name": "", "value": "", "period": ""}], "risks": ["max 3"], "recommendations": [{"action": "", "owner": ""}], "entities_mentioned": ["codes from HEALTH, EDUCATION, MUNICIPAL, TRANSPORT, LABOUR, JUSTICE, INTERIOR, COMMERCE, HOUSING, SOCIAL, CUSTOMS, DIGITAL that the document is about"], "regions_mentioned": ["names"], "sentiment": "positive|neutral|negative", "full_text": "the document text, up to 3000 characters"}
